description: LZ DONOVAN (GA 034, page 5 of AASF 1's HLZ survey book), as the field survey of October 2023 recorded it: the survey book's values typed as the book writes them, in the survey's field keys (backend/survey/fields.py, frontend/src/feature/surveys/surveyFields.js). Not generated: it is the unit's own data, approved for EZ/PZ by the owner (docs/LZ_SURVEYS.md §10, answer 2), and the input the survey tests start from. `expected` is what is known of it without a DEM: the book's grid and lat/long are about 530 m apart (§2).
name: LZ DONOVAN

field.hazards: Tall dead trees in center of LZ
